versions.subject: Add net_connection_win_susps_epmap
versions.detection:
selection:
    Protocol: tcp
    Initiated: 'true'
    DestinationPort: 135
    #DestinationPortName: epmap
filter:
    Image|startswith: C:\Windows\
condition: selection and not filter

versions.subject: False positive from amazon ssm agent updater connecting to local ip address on this port
versions.detection:
selection:
    Protocol: tcp
    Initiated: 'true'
    DestinationPort: 135
    #DestinationPortName: epmap
filter:
    Image|startswith: 
        - C:\Windows\
        - C:\ProgramData\Amazon\SSM\Update\amazon-ssm-agent-updater
condition: selection and not filter

versions.subject: Merge PR #4412 from @phantinuss
versions.detection:
selection:
    Protocol: tcp
    Initiated: 'true'
    DestinationPort: 135
    #DestinationPortName: epmap
filter_image:
    Image|startswith:
        - C:\Windows\
        - C:\ProgramData\Amazon\SSM\Update\amazon-ssm-agent-updater
filter_image_null1:
    Image: null
filter_image_null2:
    Image: ''
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_*
versions.spl: Protocol="tcp" Initiated="true" DestinationPort=135 NOT (Image IN ("C:\\Windows\\*", "C:\\ProgramData\\Amazon\\SSM\\Update\\amazon-ssm-agent-updater*") OR NOT Image=* OR Image="")
